title: Fix Claude Code skill install instructions
author: claude
head: 6430b7aa2681a26812b866c56be456d39f4a2837
body:
Claude Code doesn't have an `/install-skill` command, so the current Claude Code install step in the README (and the matching step on the website) can't be followed.

This replaces it with the documented way to add a skill: extract `coach-skill.zip` into `~/.claude/skills/coach/` (or a project's `.claude/skills/coach/`) so `SKILL.md` sits at the folder root, then start/restart Claude Code. The release zip already has `SKILL.md` at its root, so `unzip -o coach-skill.zip -d ~/.claude/skills/coach` produces the right layout (checked against a fresh `npm run build:skill`).

- `README.md`: new Claude Code install paragraph + command, link to https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills
- `docs/index.html`: same fix in the "Claude Code" tab under Getting Started

Refs #11 (leaving the issue for the maintainer to close)

install.detail: .: installed from package-lock.json using the declared locked preparation command

adjudication.reason: The PR fixes Claude Code skill install instructions in both README.md and docs/index.html. The check verifies: (1) README.md contains the correct installation path `~/.claude/skills/coach/`, (2) README.md links to the Claude Code skills documentation, (3) docs/index.html does NOT contain the broken `/install-skill` command, and (4) docs/index.html contains the proper unzip instruction. BEFORE the PR, the files would have had `/install-skill` which doesn't exist in Claude Code. AFTER the PR, they should have the correct unzip-based instructions.

mapping.assertion: docs/index.html does not link to https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills
mapping.quote: - `docs/index.html`: same fix in the "Claude Code" tab under Getting Started

adjudication.requirement: The PR fixes Claude Code skill install instructions by replacing the non-existent `/install-skill` command with documented instructions to extract `coach-skill.zip` into `~/.claude/skills/coach/`, and adds a link to the Claude Code skills documentation.

check.contents:
#!/bin/bash
# Check that the PR correctly fixes Claude Code skill install instructions

set -e

ERRORS=0

# Check 1: README.md should contain the correct installation path ~/.claude/skills/coach/
if ! grep -q '~/.claude/skills/coach' README.md; then
    echo "FAIL: README.md does not contain ~/.claude/skills/coach"
    ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
else
    echo "PASS: README.md contains ~/.claude/skills/coach"
fi

# Check 2: README.md should link to Claude Code skills documentation
if ! grep -q 'code.claude.com/docs/en/skills' README.md; then
    echo "FAIL: README.md does not link to https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills"
    ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
else
    echo "PASS: README.md links to Claude Code skills documentation"
fi

# Check 3: README.md should contain the unzip command for installing the skill
if ! grep -q 'unzip.*coach-skill.zip' README.md; then
    echo "FAIL: README.md does not contain unzip instruction for coach-skill.zip"
    ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
else
    echo "PASS: README.md contains unzip instruction"
fi

# Check 4: docs/index.html should NOT contain the broken /install-skill command
if grep -q '/install-skill' docs/index.html; then
    echo "FAIL: docs/index.html still contains the broken /install-skill command"
    ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
else
    echo "PASS: docs/index.html does not contain /install-skill"
fi

# Check 5: docs/index.html should contain the correct installation path
if ! grep -q '~/.claude/skills/coach' docs/index.html; then
    echo "FAIL: docs/index.html does not contain ~/.claude/skills/coach"
    ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
else
    echo "PASS: docs/index.html contains ~/.claude/skills/coach"
fi

# Check 6: docs/index.html should link to Claude Code skills documentation
if ! grep -q 'code.claude.com/docs/en/skills' docs/index.html; then
    echo "FAIL: docs/index.html does not link to https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills"
    ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
else
    echo "PASS: docs/index.html links to Claude Code skills documentation"
fi

if [ $ERRORS -gt 0 ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "FAILED: $ERRORS check(s) failed"
    exit 1
else
    echo ""
    echo "ALL CHECKS PASSED"
    exit 0
fi
